brief_en: Quiet start to 9 Nov Taipei time: no new official model launches, product ships or major lab announcements from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Meta AI or xAI in the last 12 hours. Prior-day items (GPT-6 Cyber, BioBasicsBench, Gemini Omni 1.2, Meta Muse updates) remain the latest confirmed activity.
brief_zh: 台北時間11月9日清晨開始安靜：過去12小時內OpenAI、Anthropic、Google DeepMind、Meta AI與xAI均無新官方模型發布、產品上線或重大宣布。前一日項目（GPT-6 Cyber、BioBasicsBench、Gemini Omni 1.2、Meta Muse更新）仍是最新確認動態。
